name: ETL Bronze (Raw Layer)
description: Ingests raw Excel files and stores unvalidated representations into the database.

name: ETL Silver (Cleaned Fact Layer)
description: Cleans, validates, deduplicates, and normalizes raw data into DWH facts.

name: ETL Gold (Marts & Views)
description: Aggregates DWH facts into user-facing business marts, metrics, and database views.

name: FastAPI Backend API Services
description: REST API endpoints managing auth, database metrics, audit status, and catalog configurations.

name: Next.js Frontend Portal
description: Web dashboard built with React and Next.js for monitoring ETL execution, managing catalogs, and reviewing quarantine.

name: Configuration and Documentation
description: Project configuration files, scripts, markdown documentation, and system variables.
